t0.why: No FIRMS pass exists between 03:36 and 11:17 PDT on 27/08, so support observed <= t0 is identical for any t0 in that gap; 10:00 precedes the first camera frame (printed 10:30) and keeps the uniform-rate integration short.

model.baseSource: simulation.html default (4 m/min); not fitted to any fire
model.coefficientsFrom: simulation.py (KW, KS, S_MIN, S_MAX) imported read-only
model.windTimeInterpolation: nearest hourly Open-Meteo value (single reanalysis point)

prior.note: dispersion of the uncertain inputs, not knowledge: unvalidated, no fuel map, no tuning

ensemble.composite: resample identified parameters by posterior weight, redraw the others from the prior

observationModel.poseTempering: likelihood of each pose within a cycle raised to 1/n_frames (frames of one pose are correlated)
observationModel.headDefinition: model-spread cells with arrival in [T-clock-activeWindow, T+clock] and local rate >= headFraction*max rate

validation.validationPasses: printed-X model: every FIRMS pass after t0 (none fitted); fitted contrast: B held-out passes only. Passes at or before t0 are initialization data and are never scored. A pass is verified by a cycle only if issue < pass time.

rules: Camera rows enter a forecast cycle only if their timestamp is at or before the cycle issue time; the verified pass must be strictly after the issue time.
FIRMS detections are never assimilated. Passes at or before t0 are initialization data and are never scored. A pass consumed by a calibration fit is never scored.
Printed-X model (no FIRMS fitted): every FIRMS pass after t0 is validation-eligible. Fitted contrast model: only B held-out passes.
No parameter, width, threshold or gate is chosen by looking at any validation score. Sensitivities are reported, not selected from.
Baseline = same model, same initialization, neutral parameters, no camera. It is always retained and always scored at the same pass time.
Verdict on the primary metric only (median nearest active-band distance, tolerance verdictDeltaM); worse results are reported as worse.
status: frozen in code before any camera observation (vision/observations.json) existed and before any real validation score was computed
limitation: A hash in a file is not an external timestamp: commit this file before running the real data to make the order auditable.
